name: Squash linguine
assumptions: Yield of 2 servings based on total dry pasta quantity (350g) being typical for 2 adult main portions in Italian recipes.
Total time of 50 minutes estimated from instructions: ~10 min prep + 35-40 min roast (using upper end) + ~10 min pasta cook/fry (overlapping with roast).
Vegetarian true per source label and no meat; Vegan null due to potential rennet in any unreferenced cheese (though none listed) and unresolved notes.
Pescatarian true as compatible with vegetarian and no meat/fish issues.
Gluten-free false due to wheat-based linguine pasta.
Dairy-free true as no milk, cheese, or dairy ingredients listed.
Allergens: Wheat true from pasta; others false or confidently absent based on listed ingredients only.
Garlic '3 parts' interpreted as 3 cloves per provided data.
Olive oil split between roasting and frying per instructions; sage fried in oil.
No compound sauces or hidden allergens assumed beyond listed items.
instructions:
Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Put the squash and garlic on a baking tray and drizzle with the olive oil. Roast for 35-40 mins until soft. Season.
Cook the pasta according to pack instructions. Drain, reserving the water. Use a stick blender to whizz the squash with 400ml cooking water. Heat some oil in a frying pan, fry the sage until crisp, then drain on kitchen paper. Tip the pasta and sauce into the pan and warm through. Scatter with sage.

ingredients.name: Butternut Squash
ingredients.assumptions: Raw butternut squash, peeled and cubed as typical for roasting; standard values for edible portion.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 3 average garlic cloves (approx 3g each); peeled weight used for roasting.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons olive oil (standard 13.6g per tbsp); used for roasting and later frying.

ingredients.name: Linguine Pasta
ingredients.assumptions: Dry linguine pasta weight before boiling; standard durum wheat values.

ingredients.name: Sage
ingredients.assumptions: Small bunch fresh sage leaves (approx 15g usable leaves); used for frying until crisp.
